name: Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 Unique Maps)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: 14 playable levels across Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea — 2 unique maps per region with 3D landmarks.
description: Standalone regional levels expansion adding all 7 Gen 3-9 regions to PokéBonk's Map Picker with 2 distinct maps each (14 levels total). Every map features its own terrain relief, color palette, weather pool, sanctuary arena, regional encounters, and a dedicated 3D centerpiece landmark. Works completely standalone with vanilla Kanto/Johto Pokémon or paired with National Dex Expansion (Gen 3-9).
highlights: Hoenn: Petalburg Canopy & Mt. Chimney Caldera
Sinnoh: Mt. Coronet Spear Pillar & Eterna Forest Chateau
Unova: Desert Resort Relic Castle & Dragonspiral Tower
Kalos: Azure Bay Sea Arch & Reflection Cave Prisms
Alola: Melemele Tapu Ruins & Wela Volcano Fire Altar
Galar: Galar Wild Area Dynamax Den & Crown Tundra Temple
Paldea: Asado Desert Titan Mesa & Area Zero Terastal Spire
requirements: Offline Mode (Mod Engine ON; works standalone or with National Dex Gen 3-9)
